name: mk-live-pro
description: MK LIVE PRO - TikTok LIVE Studio uyumlu yerel yayın yönetim yazılımı

scripts.build: vite build -c apps/studio/vite.config.ts && vite build -c apps/overlay/vite.config.ts && vite build -c apps/site/vite.config.ts && vite build -c apps/legal/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:hosted: vite build -c apps/overlay/vite.hosted.config.ts && vite build -c apps/site/vite.config.ts --mode hosted && vite build -c apps/legal/vite.config.ts --mode hosted
